tagline: A moderated space for single brothers and sisters to meet
disclaimer: Independent project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any religious entity.

home.title: Connect
home.subtitle: A private congregation area, open only to members approved by an elder.
home.purpose: To help single adults of the same faith get to know each other with a view to a serious relationship, in a supervised environment.
home.conduct1: Treat every person with dignity and respect.
home.conduct2: Be honest about who you are and what your intentions are.
home.conduct3: No inappropriate content, language, or proposals.
home.conduct4: Keep parents and elders informed about the relationship.
home.statusPending: Your request is waiting for an elder to review it.
home.statusSuspended: Your profile is suspended. Please talk to an elder.

request.title: Request access
request.subtitle: A moderating elder will review your request.
request.nickname: How you want to be called
request.bioPlaceholder: Tell us a little about your spiritual goals and what you are looking for.
request.consent: I consent to the processing of my data, including data about my religious belief, exclusively within this area.
request.acceptConduct: I have read and accept the code of conduct.
request.minAge: You must be at least 18 years old.
request.required: Please fill in all required fields.
request.success: Request sent. Please wait for an elder's approval.
request.error: The request could not be sent.
